headline: UK Core Inflation Rises Following Bank of England Rate Hold
summary: UK inflation, core CPI, and services inflation rose after the Bank of England's divided September decision to hold interest rates, prompting analysts to add rate hike possibilities to forecasts.
why: Persistent services and core inflation in the UK limits the central bank's ability to ease borrowing costs, affecting mortgage rates and gilt yields.

impacts.name: British Pound
impacts.why: Higher inflation readings heighten expectations of tighter central bank policy.

impacts.name: UK Housing
impacts.why: Prospects of sustained high interest rates maintain pressure on commercial and residential mortgage affordability.

why_moved: A rebound in core and services inflation pushed gilt yields higher and increased expectations of monetary tightening from the Bank of England.
